text:
alex.k: Heads-up — PR 8421 (alloc + KV change) caused ~10% p95 increase on longseq canary. Canary run: https://bench.dashboard/abcd :eyes:

mira.s: can you paste the bench diff? link above 404 for me.

alex.k: here's gist of the results:
```
model: mix-longseq
p95 before: 210ms
p95 after: 231ms (+10.0%)
throughput: -3%
mem p95: +12MB
```

jon.l: looks like tail bump. which change in PR is suspect?

alex.k: probable: kv.shard_split + alloc heuristics in alloc.go lines 120-184. I added microbatch affinity change.

riley: can we run a focused canary with kv disabled? quick toggle in env: KV_SHARDING=off

alex.k: kicked one off: https://bench.dashboard/run/xyz

ci-bot: Canary job 98765 started by alex.k — status: running

mira.s: if it's KV, fallback plan is to revert shard_split flag, would that require schema migration?

jon.l: no schema change. revert is just config + restart, should be safe during merge window.

riley: ack. I can approve PR if we gate merge by passing focused canary with KV off. @alex.k update when done.

alex.k: focused canary completed — p95 is back to 212ms with KV off. https://bench.dashboard/run/xyz/result

mira.s: OK that points to KV. Two approvers needed — @jon.l and @riley can you give quick :+1: to allow merge-blocking toggle approach?

jon.l: +1 to merge with KV disabled and immediate follow-up issue to root-cause and a canary to verify kv fix. :white_check_mark:

riley: +1 — will coordinate rollback plan and schedule a small maintenance window for re-enabling and testing.

alex.k: thanks. merging now in the 9:00-10:00 merge window. tagging follow-up: #issue-8472

ci-bot: Merge queued for PR 8421 — awaiting branch CI and 2 approvers.

mira.s: add note to changelog about runtime flag and fallbacks.

alex.k: will do. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
